name: yt-insights
description: YouTube channel analytics and upload tooling: pulls every upload with Analytics API metrics and retention curves, merges Studio CSV exports, builds a ranked HTML report, tracks paired upload experiments, drafts titles, descriptions, hashtags, captions and music picks in the channel's own voice, and renders exact 9:16 Shorts thumbnails, and pushes a thumbnail, metadata or captions to an uploaded video on request (separate write token, dry run by default).
